filled_text.3044: - The children are dancing under the tree over there. - Why not join them?
filled_text.3045: - The city of Wenzhou looks more and more beautiful. - Yes. That's because lots of trees are planted every year.
filled_text.3046: - The classroom looks very clean. - Yes, there isn't any rubbish on the floor.
filled_text.3047: - The classroom must be cleaned before7:30 a. m. Who's on duty today? - Alex and his group members.
filled_text.3048: - The computer is so small. - Even though, it can store large amounts of information.
filled_text.3049: - The computer must be looked after well when it is used . - I see. Neither too wet nor too hot, isn't it?
filled_text.3050: - The concert is very popular. - Yes. So far, all the tickets have been booked .
filled_text.3051: - The constant noise around here is driving me crazy. - Calm down. It's no use complaining.
filled_text.3052: - The dinner is ready. Come here, please. - OK. I'm coming .
filled_text.3053: - The dog is so cute! Can I play with him ? - Sure!
filled_text.3054: - The engineer cannot spare any time this afternoon. - If so , can we fix the computer by ourselves?
filled_text.3055: - The environment here is better than before. - I agree. There is less pollution now.
filled_text.3056: - The film Dangal was shown in our city last month and won high praise. - Exactly. I have seen it twice.
filled_text.3057: - The food is very delicious. I'm very full. - Why don't you take a walk with me?
filled_text.3058: - The food looked bad, but it tasted OK. - So we can't judge a man by his appearance.
filled_text.3059: - The football match was amazing! - Really? How I wish I had gone to the stadium with you yesterday!
filled_text.3060: - The game is very wonderful. Who designed it? - It was designed by John in 2002.
filled_text.3061: - The game last night was so good. - Yeah! Our school team won by two points.
filled_text.3062: - The girl always eats too much food. - Well, I think she should exercise every day.
filled_text.3063: - The government now is preparing for the 2022 Winter Olympics. - We should also do something for the big event.
filled_text.3064: - The house is burning ! - Let's put it out at once.
filled_text.3065: - The job you did is without any mistakes perfect. Congratulations! - Thank you.
filled_text.3066: - The lady is not strong enough to carry the heavy basket. - Let's help her.
filled_text.3067: - The lecture about 3D technology was very interesting. - It's a pity. How I wish I had had time to attend it.
filled_text.3068: - The lion looks so lovely. - Yes.
filled_text.3069: - The little girl is like looks like her mother. - You are right. They both are beautiful.
filled_text.3070: - The living conditions in the countryside have improved greatly in recent years. - The farmers are living a happier life.
filled_text.3071: - The luggage is too heavy for me. - Don't worry. I will help you carry it.
filled_text.3072: - The machine can translate simple messages into 24 different languages. - How amazing!
filled_text.3073: - The milk is very fresh. How much do you want? - Only a little, thanks.
filled_text.3074: - The mother had some hard time finding his lost son. - So she did.
filled_text.3075: - The mountain village is so beautiful. - Yes. Moreover, where the villagers live, there is fresh air.
filled_text.3076: - The movie Operation Red Sea is so exciting. Did you see it? - Yes, I have seen it twice.
filled_text.3077: - The new TV show is really great! You shouldn't miss it. - OK. I will watch it this evening.
filled_text.3078: - The new method is not perfect, but it's better than ahead ofthe old one. - Yes, you're right.
filled_text.3079: - The number of the customers in the mall grows larger and larger . - The good service here brings the guests back year after year.
filled_text.3080: - The old Chinese picture costs me as much as up to 5000 dollars. - It is worth buying.
filled_text.3081: - The pancakes here are more delicious than those from anywhere else. - Yeah, I often come here.
filled_text.3082: - The paper says Iron Man 3 is on this evening. Let's go and see it. - But I have seen it.
filled_text.3083: - The pet dog is very nice. Is it yours ? - Yes, but I'll give it to Lucy as a birthday present.
filled_text.3084: - The phone is ringing . Can you answer it, Zoey? - Sure, Mom.
filled_text.3085: - The photo makes me think of the experience at the summer camp last year. - Yeah, you wrote a story about it.
filled_text.3086: - The picture book doesn't seem so popular. What about the dictionary? - Oh, the dictionary sells well.
filled_text.3087: - The picture is not beautiful. - Why? It's more beautiful than the pictures I have ever seen.
filled_text.3088: - The pilot has flown a week. He is very tired. - OK.
filled_text.3089: - The plant looks so green. - They need plenty of water and I water them at least four times a week.
filled_text.3090: - The plot of the film is a little boring. - I agreed with you on this point to some degree to a certain degree.
filled_text.3091: - The power is off, Mom. I am going to Grandpa's. - Ok, just stay there until the power is restored .
filled_text.3092: - The price of chocolate has really gone up. - Yes, they give you so little for your money now.
filled_text.3093: - The project my father put his effort into was thought highly of. - He sets a good example for you!
filled_text.3094: - The radio says it is going to rain this afternoon, isn't it? - No. I think it will be sunny.
filled_text.3095: - The radio says it will rain tomorrow. - That's too bad . Then I can't go swimming.
filled_text.3096: - The rain is coming down so hard! - Had I taken my umbrella this morning, I wouldn't be trapped here now.
filled_text.3097: - The rain is so heavy. I am afraid it will last long. - That's possible . We are getting into rainy season anyway.
filled_text.3098: - The recent snowstorm in China is really terrible. - Yes. A lot of damage has been caused .
filled_text.3099: - The river is very dirty. Few people want to swim in it. - We should do something to save it.
filled_text.3100: - The room is dirty. - Sorry, It hasn't been cleaned for weeks and I will do it now.
filled_text.3101: - The room looks bigger! - We have changed the furniture.
filled_text.3102: - The schoolbag is really beautiful. How much is it? - It's nine dollars.
filled_text.3103: - The screen of your phone is big. - I like big screens. I can type fast on it.
filled_text.3104: - The shirt feel soft. What is it made of? - Cotton I think.
filled_text.3105: - The shirt looks different from others and it looks nice. - Thanks. It was made by my mother last month.
filled_text.3106: - The shopkeeper said they had sold out the shoes in brown. - What a pity!
filled_text.3107: - The soccer team are leaving for Japan the day after tomorrow for a game with Japan's national team. - It's a pity.
filled_text.3108: - The song is, I have to say, not a bit beautiful. - Why, it's much more beautiful than the songs I have ever heard.
filled_text.3109: - The soup is a little a bitfresh. Please add some salt to it. - OK. Wait a moment, please.
filled_text.3110: - The students have too much homework to do on weekends. - That's too bad.
filled_text.3111: - The summer vacation is coming. I'm looking forward to it. - Me too.
filled_text.3112: - The sun rose in the west this morning. - You are kidding . It is impossible.
filled_text.3113: - The sunglasses on your desk are nice. Are they yours ? - Yes, I got them from my parents as a birthday present.
filled_text.3114: - The telephone was invented in 1876. - Oh, it served for us a long time.
filled_text.3115: - The thorough cleaning of the room must have taken you quite a lot of time. - Right. It hadn't been swept for weeks.
filled_text.3116: - The tickets to Texas are not available now. - Oh. Flights sell fast at festivals.
filled_text.3117: - The tomatoes are on sale in the supermarket today. - Really? Let's go and buy them .
filled_text.3118: - The traffic is heavy now, so Mike may come late. - Let's wait ten more minutes.
filled_text.3119: - The train is leaving right now, but David hasn't arrived yet. - Well, he said he would come here on time.
filled_text.3120: - The washing machine isn't working. - I used it this morning. It was working fine then.
filled_text.3121: - The watch is so nice. Is it for me ? - Yes. Happy birthday, Mary!
filled_text.3122: - The weather is great. Let's go swimming now. - How about this afternoon? I am writing to my friend in America now.
filled_text.3123: - The weather report says it'll be rainy tomorrow. - That's too bad . I've planned to have a picnic tomorrow afternoon.
filled_text.3124: - The weather report says it's going to have a shower this afternoon. - It does? We'd better leave now, just in case.
filled_text.3125: - The weather was really cold yesterday. - Yes, it was 5 ℃ below zero.
filled_text.3126: - The weatherman says the rain will stop next week. - That's great. It is too wet these days.
filled_text.3127: - The white dress is too expensive. - What about the orange one? The price is a little lower .
filled_text.3128: - The window was cleaned just now. - Yes. It is as bright as a penny now.
filled_text.3129: - The windows are dirty. - I know. They haven't been cleaned for weeks.
filled_text.3130: - The winner is a tall and thin boy with glasses! - Well, it can't be Mike. He doesn't wear any glasses.
filled_text.3131: - The zookeeper was really annoyed with me. - How could he have been if you hadn't thrown stones at the animals?
filled_text.3132: - There will be a meeting in our school tomorrow. - Really? So many meetings this week.
filled_text.3133: - There is a meeting on in the Blue Hall. How soon will it end? - In two days.
filled_text.3134: - There used to be much garbage here. But where is it now? - Some volunteers have cleaned it up.
filled_text.3135: - There isn't mush milk at home. - Let's go shopping then.
filled_text.3136: - There are a few interesting clubs at our school. - Really? That's great!
filled_text.3137: - There are so many nice books on the shelf! Can I borrow some? - Of course.
filled_text.3138: - There are a lot more people in the zoo today than yesterday. - It's fine today. People want to go out.
filled_text.3139: - There are many trees in your garden. - Yes. They were planted by my father ten years ago.
filled_text.3140: - There are no green leaves on the tree. - I am sure it has been dead for months.
filled_text.3141: - There are quite a few people in Kuanhouli on weekends. - That must be crowded.
filled_text.3142: - There are so many girls over there. Which one is your sister? - The one whose hat is yellow.
filled_text.3143: - There are too few flowers in my garden? - So let's plant some this afternoon.
filled_text.3144: - There are too many cars on the street. - Yes, the number of the cars is getting bigger and bigger .
filled_text.3145: - There can be no life on the earth without water. - That's right. Water is needed everywhere.
filled_text.3146: - There goes the bell. - It's time for class. Let's stop talking .
filled_text.3147: - There is too much blood. Don't move him. - You're right. We need to call 120 for help.
filled_text.3148: - There is less orange in Andy's glass than in Kate's. - Yes. Kate has more orange.
filled_text.3149: - There is plenty of room for improvement in your work. - Thank you. I must work harder.
filled_text.3150: - There is a uniform on the playground. Whose is it? - I think it's Linda's.
filled_text.3151: - There is a lot of wind in North China. - Well, more trees must be planted every year to stop the wind.
filled_text.3152: - There is a police car in front of our house. - What do you think has happened ?
filled_text.3153: - There is just a little a bit of rice. We need to buy some. - OK. Anything else?
filled_text.3154: - There is little money for Mr. Lee to buy a ticket for today's show, is there ? - Exactly!
filled_text.3155: - There is no bread in the fridge. Jim, would you like to get some ? - OK, Mum.
filled_text.3156: - There is no vet here. - Don't worry. The animals were treated when they became sick.
filled_text.3157: - There is nobody here. Let's play football. - No, we can't. My father often tells me not to play in the street. It's dangerous.
filled_text.3158: - There is not enough water. - So, we shouldn't waste water.
filled_text.3159: - There isn't an empty table, would you mind sharing? - Better not . My friend just went to a toilet.
filled_text.3160: - There isn't an iPhone 7 in your schoolbag, is there? - Yes, there is . I bought one last week.
filled_text.3161: - There're so many mistakes in your homework, Daniel. - Oh, sorry. I will do my homework more carefully next time.
filled_text.3162: - There's a little bit of time left. Hurry up, or you'll miss the wonderful movie. - Yes, I'm coming!
filled_text.3163: - There's something wrong with my computer. - Don't worry. I will come to repair it tomorrow.
filled_text.3164: - These apples look very nice. Let's buy some. - But we don't have any money now.
filled_text.3165: - These lights are shining. Are they made of glass? - No, they are made of plastic.
filled_text.3166: - These potatoes are 3 yuan. - OK. I will take them .
filled_text.3167: - These young guys are really good football players. - That's true. I have trained them since 2005.
filled_text.3168: - They are talking about China's Got Talent. Let's join them. - OK. Let's go.
filled_text.3169: - They are talking about Super Voice Girl. Let's join them.  - Good idea.
filled_text.3170: - They are talking about the coming Olympic Games in Beijing. Let's join them. - Good idea.
filled_text.3171: - They are said to have been familiar with each other. - But they couldn't have been . They were introduced only hours ago.
filled_text.3172: - They did very well in the competition. No one helped them. - They should feel proud of themselves , I think.
filled_text.3173: - They have too much homework this weekend. - That's too bad.
filled_text.3174: - They won the volleyball match yesterday. - Great! We are so proud of them .
filled_text.3175: - This bicycle is the newest design of this year. - I really want to try it .
filled_text.3176: - This bike is very cool. How many is it? - About 1000 yuan.
filled_text.3177: - This blue dress looks nice on you! - Thanks. My aunt gave it to me as a present on my 15th birthday.
filled_text.3178: - This is Lucy speaking. Who's that? - This is Tom .
filled_text.3179: - This is an English book. - How nice!
filled_text.3180: - This is a really good film. - Yes, it couldn't be better .
filled_text.3181: - This is the third time he has been praised for his voluntary work for the Red Cross. - No wonder he is so excited!
filled_text.3182: - This is your first time away from home. - Don't worry, Dad. I can take care of myself .
filled_text.3183: - This kind of car is difficult to get. - Luckily, my uncle bought one last month.
filled_text.3184: - This kind of magazine sells well. - You are right. All these in my shop were sold out within two hours this morning.
filled_text.3185: - This kind of watch is much cheaper today than last month. Would you like to have one? - Really? I'll take one.
filled_text.3186: - This living room is so clean! Who helped you clean it up? - Actually I did it all by myself .
filled_text.3187: - This morning I got up too late to catch the school bus. - That's too bad. You should go to bed early.
filled_text.3188: - This new cinema is so big. - Yeah. It's the biggest one in our city.
filled_text.3189: - This new computer magazine is really nice. Is it yours ? - Yes. We can share it together.
filled_text.3190: - This new toy is for you. - Thank you.
filled_text.3191: - This pair of blue jeans looks cool. Can I try them on? - Sure. The fitting room is over there.
filled_text.3192: - This pen doesn't write well. Could you pass me another one? - Here you are.
filled_text.3193: - This photo makes me think of the trip to the Great Wall last year. - Yeah, we had a great time there.
filled_text.3194: - This sweater is too expensive. I can't afford it. - How about this one? It's much cheaper .
filled_text.3195: - This tie looks cool. How much is it? - It's on sale, only $99.
filled_text.3196: - This year is special for us Chinese. - More than70 years has passed since China was set up.
filled_text.3197: - Tim offers to make a birthday cake for Jim. - Great! Let's help him.
filled_text.3198: - Tim, put on your coat, or you may have a cold on such a cold day. - OK, Mom.
filled_text.3199: - Tina together with a few other classmates is coming to our party next Sunday. - Good news! I can't wait to see them.
filled_text.3200: - Tina, could you please play the piano for me while I'm singing? - With pleasure.
filled_text.3201: - Tina, is this your schoolbag? - Yes, it's mine.
filled_text.3202: - Today is the happiest day in my life, because I won the first prize in the competition. - Congratulation!
filled_text.3203: - Today mobile phones are used everywhere and every moment. - Yes. It's convenient. But using too much is really bad for eyes.
filled_text.3204: - Today's drinks are on Harold! - Agreed!
filled_text.3205: - Tom came to work last Friday, but no one has seen him since. - Could he have had an accident?
filled_text.3206: - Tom can speak three languages, can't he? - Yes. He can also speak French and Japanese besides English.
filled_text.3207: - Tom has been to the Great Wall at least three times. - So have I .
filled_text.3208: - Tom has been working for more than 9 hours! - He must be very tired.
filled_text.3209: - Tom knows little about Japanese history. - That's why he can't answer the questions about it.
filled_text.3210: - Tom knows little about our Chinese history. - So it's difficult for him to tell his patents about China.
filled_text.3211: - Tom! I looked for you everywhere at the party last night. - Oh, I wasn't invited to the party.
filled_text.3212: - Tom, I called you last night, but nobody answered. - Oh, I was seeing the film Operation Red Sea with my parents.
filled_text.3213: - Tom, Mary can't sharpen the pencil. Can you give her a hand? - Certainly.
filled_text.3214: - Tom, where are the twins? - They're in the garden, I think.
filled_text.3215: - Tom, can you sing an English song? - No, I can't.
filled_text.3216: - Tom, be quiet! The baby is sleeping in the next room. - Oh, sorry.
filled_text.3217: - Tom, can I borrow your book Chicken Soapy? - Sorry, I have lent it to Mary.
filled_text.3218: - Tom, do you have an art room in your school? - Yes, we have one.
filled_text.3219: - Tom, don't play with fire, you may hurt yourself. - OK, mum.
filled_text.3220: - Tom, here is your dictionary. Sorry not to have returned it earlier. - I was wondering where it was.
filled_text.3221: - Tom, hurry up! We are waiting for you. - Just one minute.
filled_text.3222: - Tom, if you make so many mistakes again, you'll lose your job. - Sorry, sir.
filled_text.3223: - Tom, let's go skating! - Can you wait a moment? I am doing my homework.
filled_text.3224: - Tom, look at your clothes! - Sorry, Mum. I played football in the park and I'll wash them right now.
filled_text.3225: - Tom, my glasses are in my room. Can you bring them here for me? - Sure, grandma.
filled_text.3226: - Tom, open the beer bottle. - What can I open it with ?
filled_text.3227: - Tom, pass me the apples, please. - Sorry, I am watching a movie. Let Lisa do it.
filled_text.3228: - Tom, please tell Jack the good news. - I don't have to . His father has told him about it already.
filled_text.3229: - Tom, remember to wash your hands before eating. - Yes, mom. I will.
filled_text.3230: - Tom, there will be a heavy rain this afternoon. - I know, Mum. I will take an umbrella.
filled_text.3231: - Tom, what do you do after dinner every day? - I usually take a walk.
filled_text.3232: - Tom, what's your dad doing? - He is repairing my bike.
filled_text.3233: - Tom, where do you work? - I work in a shop which sells different kinds of vegetables.
filled_text.3234: - Tom, where is Ben?  - Look, he is painting the fence for me in the garden.
filled_text.3235: - Tom, where is Miss Wang? - She is giving a speech on Chinese culture in the school gym.
filled_text.3236: - Tom, where is your manager? - He with his workmates has been in Shanghai on business for a few days.
filled_text.3237: - Tom, where's your dad? - Oh, mum, he is repairing his bike in the yard.
filled_text.3238: - Tom, which subject is easier for you, physics or chemistry? - Chemistry. I think.
filled_text.3239: - Tom, why are you playing? What about your homework? - Mum, I have finished it, so I can play now.
filled_text.3240: - Tom, why are you so busy? - I am making some plans to work in an old people's home this summer.
filled_text.3241: - Tom, will Jenny join us in the book sale tomorrow? - I'm afraid not. She hurt herself badly while playing tennis.
filled_text.3242: - Tom, will you pay for all or go Dutch when dining out ? - Last time Peter treated , this is on me.
filled_text.3243: - Tom, would you please take out the rubbish? - Just a minute, mom. I am making a phone call.
filled_text.3244: - Tom, you are wanted on the phone. - I am coming.
filled_text.3245: - Tom, you have woken up the baby! - I'm sorry. I shouldn't slam the door.
filled_text.3246: - Tomorrow is Fathers' Day. What gift shall we get for Dad? - Let's give him a baseball. He likes sports.
filled_text.3247: - Tomorrow my dad will cook a big dinner for my birthday party. - Sounds great! Have a good time.
filled_text.3248: - Tony looks tired. - Yes, he's training hard for a big match against HAS next Sunday afternoon.
filled_text.3249: - Tony looks unhappy these days. - I guess something bad has happened to him.
filled_text.3250: - Tony, take a camera with you, so you can take photos of Jinan. - OH. Thanks, Mom.
filled_text.3251: - Tony, is Mike your twin brother? - Yes, and I am 2 cm taller than him.
filled_text.3252: - Tony, where is your brother? - Behind the house. He is washing his car.
filled_text.3253: - Tony, why are your eyes red? - I have been cutting up peppers for the last five minutes.
filled_text.3254: - Tony, you look puzzled. Have you understood me? - I'm sorry. I was thinking of another problem just now.
filled_text.3255: - Tracy, what do you usually do after dinner every day? - I usually walk the dog in the park.
filled_text.3256: - Two Taizhou Daily Papers, please! - Sorry, there is the last one left here, would you like to have it ?
filled_text.3257: - Two cups of milk tea, please. - Sorry, but we have sold out . How about juice?
filled_text.3258: - Uncle David has already arrived at Beijing Airport. - Really? I expect to see him early.
filled_text.3259: - Uncle Sam said he would attend my birthday party, but he never showed up. - That's Uncle Sam. He forgets everything!
filled_text.3260: - Uncle Wang, I got to your home at 6:00 p. m. yesterday, but nobody was in. - Oh, I was having a meeting.
filled_text.3261: - Wait until we get a satisfactory reply, will you? - I couldn't agree more . The idea sounds great to me.
filled_text.3262: - Waiter! I'd like some Shaoyang rice noodles. - Sorry, sir. Rice noodles are served only in the morning.
filled_text.3263: - Waiter, I'd like a glass of fresh grape juice. - Sorry, Madam. Grape juice is served only in summer days.
filled_text.3264: - Waiter, I'd like some Ningbo Dumplings. - Sorry, sir. Ningbo Dumplings are served only for lunch and dinner.
filled_text.3265: - Waiter, I'd like some Yangzhou Fried Rice. - Sorry, sir. We only have it for lunch and dinner.
filled_text.3266: - Waiter, a glass of orange juice, please. - Sorry. Orange juice is served only for breakfast.
filled_text.3267: - Wang Li is the winner of the photo competition. - Yes. She manages to show the different colors on the hill.
filled_text.3268: - Was David's speech successful? - I suppose so. He was practicing it till the last minute.
filled_text.3269: - Was Kate at the party last night? - Yes, she was wearing a really nice dress.
filled_text.3270: - Was Peter at the party when you arrived? - No, he had gone home.
filled_text.3271: - Was it by cutting down staff that she saved the firm? - No, it was by improving work efficiency.
filled_text.3272: - Was the cup broken by Tom? - Yes, it was.
filled_text.3273: - Was the weather OK? - Yes, it was .
filled_text.3274: - Was your sister at home when I called you? - Yes. She was reading in her room.
filled_text.3275: - Washing machines make our lives easier more convenient. - That's right.
filled_text.3276: - We Chinese like drinking wine made from rice. - Really? It's quite different from us.
filled_text.3277: - We will have a basketball game against Class 3 next Sunday. - Well done! What time is it?
filled_text.3278: - We have bought a new house in the center of the city. - Really? When are you moving in?
filled_text.3279: - We haven't seen each other in the last 10 years. - Yes. More kindness and warmth in your heart.
filled_text.3280: - We will walk home if there is no bus. - Oh, what a pity!
filled_text.3281: - We mustn't take photos when visiting the Province Museum. - I can't agree with you more.
filled_text.3282: - We were told that the airplane was called off. - That's too bad.
filled_text.3283: - We will visit the Summer Palace next Sunday. - Have a good trip.
filled_text.3284: - We will go to Yun Brocade Museum with the exchange students this coming summer holiday. - That's amazing!
filled_text.3285: - We are happy to have more free time than before. - Well, we need time to relax.
filled_text.3286: - We are happy to see our city is developing more quickly these years than before. - So am I.
filled_text.3287: - We are leaving now, Tina. - Wait a minute. I haven't got things ready.
filled_text.3288: - We are looking for somebody who is fluent in Spanish. - No problem. I studied Spanish for four years at college.
filled_text.3289: - We are playing basketball now. Would you like to join us ? - Sure.
filled_text.3290: - We can finish the work with fewer people and less money. - Really? Well done.
filled_text.3291: - We can pick apples in autumn. - That sounds like a lot of fun.
filled_text.3292: - We can sing and dance at the party. - That sounds like a lot of fun.
filled_text.3293: - We don't have much time. - Let's be quick.
filled_text.3294: - We don't have enough food for the party. - I will go and buy some.
filled_text.3295: - We don't have enough meat in the fridge. - I will buy some more in the supermarket soon.
filled_text.3296: - We have a lot of cakes here. Help yourselves to some more ,kids. - Thank you.
filled_text.3297: - We have so many sweets here! - So we haven't got to buy any.
filled_text.3298: - We haven't got any milk in the fridge. - Let's go and get some.
filled_text.3299: - We haven't got enough milk. Let's go shopping for some. - OK! How much would you like?
filled_text.3300: - We lost the football game again. - Don't be so sad. In competition, as in life, you may not always win.
filled_text.3301: - We lost the football match last week. - That's too bad ! Good luck to you next time.
filled_text.3302: - We must be careful as we work. - Yes. The more careful we are, the fewer mistakes we'll make.
